notes: Single months swing widely once annualized, so the verdict reads the whole window from 2025-12-01 to 2026-11-01, not the bars.
NEAR's supply grew more slowly in 8 of the 11 months with both readings.
Consumer prices are the seasonally adjusted CPI-U, a monthly average, so each month's reading is centred about half a month before NEAR's month-boundary samples.
Months without a reading, because the month before has no published consumer-price level: 2025-11 (CPI for 2025-10 not published).
From the first sample after 2025-10-29 to the latest, NEAR's supply grew 2.48% a year.
